PlayerPredictorMLB

The goal of PlayerPredictorMLB is to explore MLB statistics from recent seasons and use them to help predict future outcomes and value. The package focuses on expected stats, including functions that can help you predict a player’s xBA, xSLG, xwOBA, xERA, and xFIP, find similar players, and calculate the monetary value of production based on a player’s WAR.

Installation

You can install the development version of PlayerPredictorMLB from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("ayaghmour2/PlayerPredictorMLB")

Data

The data used for this package comes from https://www.fangraphs.com/. It covers batting and pitching statistics from the 2021 to 2026 MLB season. Each function gives a quick definition of the variables used, but for a more detailed definition, you can visity the glossary at https://library.fangraphs.com/. The default datasets are built into the functions, but users can use their own data instead, assuming they have all necessary variables. The prediction functions are built on data from 2021 to 2026, so it may not be useful using data from previous seasons, especially the shortened 2020 season.

Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to find similar batters:

batting_results <- similar_batters(
 bb_pct = 11,
 k_pct = 27,
 hr_fb = 24,
 barrel_pct = 14,
 hardhit_pct = 50,
 xba = 0.265,
 xslg = 0.500,
 xwoba = 0.378,
 n = 10
)
batting_results

This is a basic example which shows you how to find similar pitchers, specifically a traditional starting pitcher:

starter_results <- similar_pitchers(
 lob_pct = 81,
 gb_pct = 43,
 hr_fb = 9,
 k_pct = 30,
 bb_pct = 6,
 barrel_pct = 7,
 hardhit_pct = 38,
 is_starter = 1,
 is_reliever = 0,
 n = 10
)
starter_results

#> 1    Cam Schlittler   2026  25 193.2 14  6  0 1.95 0.92 239 49
#> 2       Gerrit Cole   2023  32 209.0 15  4  0 2.63 0.98 222 48
#> 3    Walker Buehler   2021  26 207.2 16  4  0 2.47 0.97 212 52

This is a basic example which would predict a player’s wOBA:

example_woba <-predict_woba(
 age = 27,
 xba = 0.280,
 xslg = 0.400,
 xwoba = 0.331,
 bb_pct = 9.2,
 k_pct = 13.3,
 iso = 0.096,
 wrc_plus = 95,
 hr_fb = 5.7,
 barrel_pct = 6.9,
 hardhit_pct = 44.3
)
example_woba
#> [1] 0.325

This is a basic example which would predict a player’s ERA:

example_era <-predict_era(
  age = 25,
  babip = 0.251,
  hr_fb = 9.1,
  xera = 2.85,
  xfip = 2.86,
  ip = 193.2,
  lob_pct = 81.7,
  k_pct = 31.4,
  bb_pct = 6.4,
  barrel_pct = 7.3,
  hardhit_pct = 38.1,
  is_starter = 1,
  is_reliever = 0
)
example_era
#> [1] 3.67

This is a basic example which would calculate a player’s value based on WAR:

dollar_value <- WAR_dollar_value_calculator(war = 7, seasons = 3)
#> Estimated Annual Value: $19,833,333
dollar_value
#> [1] 19833333
